### God Knows
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/god-knows
Passage: Exodus 2:25
Points:
- In the midst of Israel's bitter suffering in Egypt, God was intimately aware of each person's pain and oppression.
- God did not merely react to their misery; He had foreknown their affliction centuries earlier in His covenant promise to Abraham.
- Afflictions carry a divine purpose and timetable that often extend far beyond immediate human comprehension.
- Believers can take deep comfort in the truth that God sees, understands, and actively cares about their distress.
- Through Christ, God guarantees a greater exodus that turns all temporary suffering toward eternal good.

### On Its Way – Part 1
Author: Whitney Capps
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-aug-12-2008-11580361.html
Passage: Exodus 2:23-25
Points:
- The emphatic repetition of God's name reveals that He is entirely in control of what will unfold.
- Even before the Israelites saw the answer to their groaning, God was already working behind the scenes.
- Seeking God requires patience, as His provision often begins moving before we even speak our requests.
- God is intimately familiar with our needs and orchestrates circumstances for our good and His glory.
- Believers can trade anxiety for peace by trusting that God's deliverance may already be on its way.
